g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6.4 - MQTT telemetry ingress and persistence
Consumer timing relative to CONNACK is not guaranteed.
Telemetry publish and early protocol acknowledgement
PUBACK is coupled to Rule Engine Queue producer success.
It does not wait for queue consumption or database persistence.
saveAndNotify(tenantId, customerId, entityId, entries, ttl, callback)
check API usage, entity and values
ensure RANGE partition + batch upsert ts_kv
History and latest writes are aggregated with Futures.allAsList.
They are not one cross-queue or cross-DAO transaction;
a completed child write is not rolled back when another child fails.
